newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: South American port conditions - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: South American port conditions - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

ARGENTINA, July 29 - Santa Fe - No vessels berthed/in roads/due. Max. recommended draft 29 ft. 01 in. at access channel. Diamante - No vessels berthed/in roads/due. Max. recommended draft 29 ft. 3 in. at passage KM. 520. San Lorenzo - Seven vessels berthed of which 2 loading sbmp, 2 loading sbm, 2 loading sbo, 1 loading maize. 37 Vessels due at 6 terminals during coming week. Forecast indicates that draft stable during next week. Pasa berth draft 23 ft. 08 in. fw. Rosario - Four vessels berthed of which 1 loading maize, 1 loading sugar, 1 loading sbm, 1 loading fruit. 2 Vessels in roads, 13 due during coming week. Forecast indicates the draft stable during next week.

Villa Constitucion - Two vessels berthed of which 1 discharging iron ore, 1 loading maize. No vessels in roads, 1 due. Elevator berths - Max. draft 22 ft. fw. San Nicolas - Four vessels berthed of which 1 discharging iron ore, 1 discharging coal, 2 discharging steel products. 2 Vessels in roads, 9 due during the coming week. Forecast indicates draft stable during the coming week. San Pedro - One vessel loading maize, 1 in roads, none due. San Lorenzo, Rosario, San Nicolas, San Pedro - Max recommended draft 32 ft. 06 in./33 ft fw high tide. Buenos Aires - 18 Vessels in port, 27 due during coming week. Max. recommended draft 31 ft. 06 in. Fw high tide NAABSA (guided by entrance channel. Dock sud - Max recommended draft 28/29 ft. fw. high tide NAABSA.

Necochea - Four vessels berthed of which 1 loading sfo, 1 discharging dap, 2 discharging urea. 2 Vessels in roads, 10 due during week. Max. recommended draft 40 ft. Bw. Bahia Blanca - Seven vessels berthed of which 2 awaiting orders, 1 loading sunflowerseed, 1 loading sfp, 1 discharging urea, 1 loading fuel oil, 1 loading crude oil. 2 Vessels in roads, 8 due during the week. Draft depends on each berth.

BRAZIL, July 29 - Vitoria - Vessels berthed, 1 paper coils loader, 2 bulk wheat loaders, 2 granite, 1 container/general cargo discharger/loader, 1 vehicles discharger, 1 pig iron loader, 1 general cargo discharger, 1 vehicles discharger. Tubarao - 3 Steel products loaders, 1 fuel discharger. Praia Mole - 3 Steel products loaders, 2 coal dischargers. Portocel - 1 Cellulose loader. 20 Vessels waiting in roads. Santos - Vessels berthed, 1 full container loader/discharger, 3 general cargo/container dischargers, 1 bulk cement, 1 bulk chemical products discharger, 2 bulk fertiliser dischargers, 9 sugar loaders, 1 bulk sulphur loader, 1 bulk pellets loader, 1 bulk wheat discharger, 1 bulk diesel oil loader. 35 Vessels waiting in roads, 104 due during next 7 days.

Private terminals - Cosipa - 1 Iron ore discharger, 1 steel products loader, 1 bulk coal discharger. Ultrafertil - 1 Bulk fertiliser discharger. Rio de Janeiro - Vessels berthed, 2 general cargo/steel products dischargers, 1 general cargo/container discharger, 2 wheat dischargers, 2 steel products loaders, 3 sugar loaders. Tecon - 2 Vessels, 33 due during next 7 days. Sao Sebastiao - Tebar - 1 Vessel berthed, 5 due during next 7 days. Rio Grande - Vessels berthed, 5 full container loaders, 2 soy loads, 1 soybean loader, 1 wheat discharger, 2 fertiliser dischargers, 1 benzene loader. 1 Waiting in roads, 12 due during next 10 days.

CHILE, July 28 - Arica - Two vessels in terminal, 4 berths vacant. 9 Vessels due during the week. Port working normally. Iquique - Four vessels berthed, 16 due during the week. Antofagasta - Four vessels berthed, 1 berth available. 6 Vessels due during the week for loading and discharging concentrates, bulk copper, containers and general cargo. Valparaiso - Three vessels berthed working normally, 6 berths vacant, 1 berth out of service due to enlargement of pier 2 until April 1998. 12 Vessels due during the week. San Antonio - Six vessels operating, berths vacant. 19 Vessels due during the week. Port working normally. Conception Bay ports - Talcahuano - One vessel berthed, 3 due during the week, none waiting in roads.

San Vicente - Three vessels berthed working normally, 7 due during the week. Navy pier (Molo 500) - 1 Vessel berthed, 1 berth out of service, 1 vessel due during the week. Steel pier - 1 Vessel berthed at terminal, none due during the week. Coronel pier - 1 Vessel berthed at terminal, none due. Oil terminal - 1 Vessel berthed, none due. Lirquen - No vessels berthed, 6 berths available. 4 Vessels due during the week. Penco - No vessels due. Puerto Montt - One vessel in port, 7 due during the week. Punta Arenas - Two vessels berthed, 1 due during the week.

VENEZUELA, July 28 - Puerto Cabello - Five vessels anchored. 13 Vessels berthed of which 5 grain, 5 general cargo, 1 bulk cargo, 2 container vessels. Piers 1 and 2 closed. Guanta - One general cargo vessel berthed. July 29 - Orinoco river - Draft 35 ft. 0 in. Puerto Ordaz - Two vessels operating of which 1 loading/discharging generals, 1 loading iron ore, 4 due. Boca Grande - Three vessels loading iron ore. Palua - Two vessels loading iron ore, 1 due. Mile 178 - Two vessels waiting at anchorage to load/discharge. Matanzas - One vessel waiting at anchorage to load, 6 loading steel products, 5 due. San Felix - One vessel loading/discharging generals. Punta Cuchillo - Two vessels due. Venalum - Two vessels loading aluminum. Interalumina - One vessel loading alumina. Puerto Cabello - 15 Vessels loading/discharging generals, 12 due, 2 under repair.

Guanta - Three vessels operating of which 2 loading/discharging generals, 1 discharging tuna fish, 6 due. La Guaira - Three vessels loading/discharging generals, 9 due, 3 under repair, 1 passenger vessel. Amuay - One vessel waiting at anchorage to load, 2 loading refined products. Cardon - Two vessels waiting at anchorage to load, 2 loading refined products. Guaranao - One vessel discharging bananas. Bajo Grande - One vessel loading refined products, 2 due. La Ceiba - One vessel due. El Tablazo - One vessel loading urea. Venterminales - Three vessels due. Puerto Sucre - One vessel due. All ports working normally.
